subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should maintainers adopt this PR's first-run Tailscale connection chooser as part of the current iOS onboarding direction, or narrow/close it in favor of the merged onboarding and one-step setup work?
rationale: The patch is useful and proof-backed, but it changes first-run UX and a security-sensitive Gateway route while conflicting with newer current-main onboarding and pairing work.

options.title: Rebase and narrow onto current main
options.body: Preserve the unique Tailscale/MagicDNS chooser and raw-IP rejection while keeping current main's merged onboarding, typography, setup-code route candidates, and Gateway trust registry behavior.

options.title: Fold into one-step setup work
options.body: Move any remaining Tailscale-specific copy or validation into the open mobile setup PRs if maintainers want QR/setup-code to remain the primary onboarding path.

options.title: Pause or close this direction
options.body: Close or park the PR if maintainers do not want a separate first-run Tailscale chooser in the iOS app.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow onto current main
recommendation.body: Preserve the unique Tailscale/MagicDNS chooser and raw-IP rejection while keeping current main's merged onboarding, typography, setup-code route candidates, and Gateway trust registry behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about product/security direction around iOS Gateway setup and Tailnet route behavior, where recent adjacent work points to steipete.
